name: Polymer
summary: Tool for AI-generated dashboards, conversational analytics and embedded analytics.
description: Polymer builds dashboards and interactive reports from connected data sources and suggests insights with AI. It also offers conversational analytics and embedded analytics through an API, for companies that want to show charts inside their own products. Paid plans start at $20 per month; Pro has a 14-day free trial and costs $40 per month. Students and educators can use it for free.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists Starter at $20 per month, or $10 per month billed yearly, and Pro at $40 per month with a 14-day trial. No general free plan was shown.

howToUse.title: Open Polymer
howToUse.description: Open Polymer and connect a data source such as a spreadsheet upload or one of the listed integrations.

howToUse.title: Build dashboards and reports
howToUse.description: Polymer builds dashboards and interactive reports from those connected sources and suggests insights.

howToUse.title: Ask questions or embed charts
howToUse.description: Use conversational analytics so a question becomes charts, or use embedded analytics through the API so companies can show charts inside their own products.

howToUse.title: Start a paid plan or the classroom offer
howToUse.description: Paid plans start at $20 per month. Pro has a 14-day trial and costs $40 per month. Students and educators can use Polymer for free.
